AXIOM-ADJACENT, derive consequences only; nothing here assumes re-recording is admissible. The campaign's formation law writes each record once. Suppose instead a site's record is re-drawn from the covariant rule K(s | neighbours) prop. to exp(beta s.S), S the sum of the CURRENT records of its six neighbours on Z^3. (a) Asynchronous re-recording (one site at a time, any clock rates): show by exact detailed balance on finite windows that the stationary law is the static law exp(beta sum s.s') -- so the 'frozen' comparator of blocks 01-24 would be the equilibrium of a universe in which records keep re-forming, and block 19's Green-function kernel its equal-time covariance. (b) Synchronous re-recording (all sites at once): show the chain is reversible with respect to pi(s) prop. to prod_x Z(beta |S_x(s)|), Z the normalizer of the rule (the symmetry sum_x s'_x.S_x(s) = sum_x s_x.S_x(s') is the key), a Gibbs law with a many-body interaction; compute its small-window marginals exactly for the six-axis menu and compare with the static law; decide whether it orders and what its transverse kernel is at large beta (sphere menu: expand log Z(beta|S|)). (c) Which of the programme's results (uniqueness regions, the ordered side, the kernel, the menus) transfer to each case. Deliver exact finite checks for every identity. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/re-recording/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
